metadata.title: Threat Detection

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Threat detection logic is aligned to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and adversary behaviors.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Supports detection across Credential Access, Discovery, Lateral Movement, Collection, and Command and Control.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Threat detection aligns with D3FEND detection, behavioral analysis, and analytic reasoning techniques.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Provides analytic capabilities to identify, confirm, and prioritize malicious activity.

metadata.remarks: Threat Detection defines the capability to identify malicious or hostile activity within institutional environments using detection rules, behavioral analytics, and threat intelligence. This pattern determines whether observed activity represents a security threat and prioritizes findings for response but does not itself execute containment or remediation actions.

components.title: Detection Rules and Analytics
components.description: Use of signature-based, behavioral, and heuristic analytics to identify malicious activity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Employ automated mechanisms to detect indicators of malicious activity.

components.title: Threat Intelligence Integration
components.description: Incorporation of internal and external threat intelligence to enrich detection capability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Incorporate threat intelligence to support identification of evolving threats.

components.title: Threat Triage and Prioritization
components.description: Assessment and prioritization of detected threats based on severity, confidence, and impact.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Prioritize detected threats to support timely and effective incident response.
